title: Counting Words with Counter and CountVectorizer
learning_objectives: Find the most common words with collections.Counter
Turn documents into a word-count matrix with CountVectorizer
Remove stop words and rare words with stop_words and min_df
entry_point: top_words(texts, k, stop_words=()); count_matrix(texts, stop_words=None, min_df=1)
hints: Update one Counter with the filtered tokens of every text.
`sorted(counts.items(), key=lambda item: (-item[1], item[0]))[:k]` gives the ordering.

failure_feedback.advice: Fit CountVectorizer(stop_words=...) and return get_feature_names_out() and the dense rows.
Return plain str and int values.
